content:
Are you passionate about Lean and any of the following areas?

  • Software Verification
  • Automated Reasoning (AR)
  • Combining AR+AI

If so, we'd love to have you consider joining us for an internship. Dive deep into Lean and gain hands-on experience at AWS.

To kickstart your application:
:mail_sent: Send your CV to @Soonho Kong (soonho@amazon.com).

More information:

  • We have multiple internship openings for PhD students, as well as for Master's and undergraduate students.
  • We are flexible with internship start dates. It is fine as long as you can start between January 1, 2024 and October 1, 2024.
  • The standard internship period is 14 weeks, but it can be adjusted or extended upon request.

If you have any questions about the AWS internship, please feel free to email me (soonho@amazon.com).
@Tomaz Gomes , no. It will be in person by the company policy.
In that case, it might be interesting to mention where :)

It depends on the team that you will work with. We have teams in US and Europe. Major hubs include:

  • US: Seattle, SF Bay area, Boston, Washington DC area, Minneapolis, NYC.
  • Europe: Munich (Germany) and London (UK)
Will there be similar internships next year as well? :fingers_crossed:

FYI, over 20 people have applied so far! The formal hiring process has not yet started due to some internal delays. I have shared candidates' resumes with teams using Lean in their projects. I will contact you again when the official process begins. At that time, you will be asked to officially apply through https://amazon.jobs. Selected candidates will receive emails from Amazon HR and be scheduled for interviews.
@Tariq Erwa , I don't have the deadline at this stage, but I expect mid December this year.
Will the formal hiring process start soon?
